name: Theurge (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
body:
The theurge studies the magic power of the divine.

They do not have any special faith or piety – they merely study the gods as one would study dragons. Gods exist but can be understood.

Symbols of Power: A theurge can use divine foci as material components as a cleric would to replace the material components of some spells. They may also benefit from any special properties a divine focus they are using possesses.

Theurgic Reservoir: All the theurge’s class abilities, including their arcane reservoir and all of their exploits, use Wisdom in place of Charisma.

Theurgic Affinity: The theurge gains the theurgic affinity, which includes the following spells:

0th—detect fiendish presence, enhanced diplomacy, guidance, resistance, 1st—bane, bless, bless water, blessed fist, blessing of the watch, celestial healing, curse water, detect demon, detect the faithful, divine favor, hex ward, infernal healing, protection from chaos, protection from evil, protection from good, protection from law, see alignment, shield of faith, weapons against evil
2nd—abeyance, align weapon, angelic aspect, lesser, consecrate, desecrate, dread bolt, early judgement, holy ice weapon, imbue with aura, instrument of agony, protection from chaos, communal, protection from evil, communal, protection from good, communal, protection from law, communal, protection from outsiders, sacred space, shard of chaos, spear of purity, unholy ice weapon
3rd—align weapon, communal, aura sight, damnation, holy javelin, magic circle against chaos/evil/good/law, mark of obvious ethics, vision of hell
4th—antithetical constraint, ardor’s onslaught, celestial healing, greater, chaos hammer, crusader’s edge, guardian of faith, holy smite, infernal healing, greater, order’s wrath, unholy blight
5th—angelic aspect, atonement, dismissal, dispel balance, dispel chaos/evil/good/law, hallow, unhallow
6th—eaglesoul, planar ally, planar binding, planeslayer’s call, summon infernal host, unholy ice
7th—archon’s trumpet, blasphemy, dictum, destruction, holy word, word of chaos
8th—angelic aspect, greater, cloak of chaos, counterbalancing aura, death clutch, divine vessel, false resurrection, holy aura, planar ally, greater, planar binding, greater, sacramental seal, shield of law, unholy aura
9th—false resurrection, greater, judgment undone

These spells are arcane spells, and the theurge is still an arcane caster.

This replaces one of the arcane affinities gained at 1st level.

Divine Domain

The theurge has learned enough about divine power to acquire a domain. They choose one clerical domain: at 1st level, they add all that domain’s domain spells to their spell list as part of their theurgic affinity.

They also gain the 1st level domain power as if they were a cleric of equal level.

This replaces the arcanist exploits gained at 1st and 10th level.

Arcanist Exploits

A theurge can select from the following additional exploits.

Arcane Orisons (Ex)

The theurge may add all orisons from the cleric spell list to their spell list as part of the theurgic affinity.

Domain Mastery (Su)

The theurge gains the higher-level domain power of their domain, using their class level as their cleric level.

They must have achieved a class level high enough to gain that ability to take this exploit.
